bio: Based globally. Previously shipping at scale with Amazon Web Services, Coca-Cola, Zoox, McLaren, and Intuit. I specialize in building interfaces that marry technical precision with craft — high-performance React applications, design systems, and AI-powered experiences.
Every project is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what the browser can do. I'm drawn to the intersection of engineering rigor and creative expression.
